blocks.text: Zscaler Cellular audit logs allow you to view a record of all administrative actions performed in the Zscaler Cellular configurations. It helps track configuration changes, identify who performed an action, and understand when the action occurred.
Zscaler Cellular audit logs provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Gain visibility into all administrative actions performed in the Zscaler Cellular environment
Track who performed an action and when it occurred
Quickly identify and troubleshoot configuration changes
Maintain an auditable record of system activity
Filter and analyze logs to investigate specific events efficiently

blocks.heading: About the Zscaler Cellular Audit Logs Page

blocks.text: On the Zscaler Cellular Audit Logs page (Data Explorer > Audit Logs > Cellular), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Apply time filters to view log entries specific to that period.
Refresh the table data.
Add or remove columns from the table.
Show or hide filtering options.
Apply filters based on specific parameters. For each parameter, you can specify a value to filter the table data.
View audit log entries based on the applied filters. For each log entry, you can view:
Timestamp: The date and time when the action occurred.
Principal ID: The user or system that performed the action.
Action: The type of operation performed, such as Create or Update.
Resource Type: The type of resource affected (for example, Tag, SIM to Tag Mapping, or Anomaly Policy).
Resource Name: The name of the affected resource.
Resource ID: The unique identifier of the resource.
View Changes: View details of the configuration changes.
See image.
Limit the number of records displayed per page. You can choose to display 10, 25, 50, or 100 entries per page.
Go to a specific page or move to the next or previous page.
